high_level_description: A single small terrier in a low digging pose on grassy ground under a pale sky, rendered in a clean structural layout on a 1600x900 landscape canvas with earthy and soft pastel tones.

style_description.aesthetics: Minimalist, schematic, anatomically suggestive but non-realistic

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale blue sky occupying upper 750px; layered grass band (green tones) occupying lower 150px

elements.desc: Terrier silhouette: head (circle), torso (oval), four legs (ovals), brown leather harness as central strap across chest and back
